Watch out for that Molten Mech!|audio=MoltenWave23-2.ogg|[[Professor V]] dialogue on Wave 23 ([[Molten Mode|Molten]])}}}} ==Description== The '''Molten Mech''' is a fast and tanky enemy that appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It could also appear in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has decently high health, but lower than the [[Molten Golem]], a fairly quick speed and some defense. ==Appereance== The '''Molten Mech''' is, as the name suggest, a giant mech. Its body is made out of red and black metal parts. Its head has a small neon orange lens. Multiple neon orange parts can be seen on its body. It has three thrusters on each of its arms, which are used to boost its speed. It also has a black skull symbol on each hand's side. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] or [[Crook Boss]] can be quite useful against the '''Molten Mech'''. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of these towers. *Stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Tesla]], [[Freezer]] and [[Cryomancer]] can be used to slow it down. **These towers can also be used to reduce its [[Defense]], though as it is quite low this will have minimal impact on the damage it receives. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} MoltenMechWalkAnimation.gif|Walk animation (11 December 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MoltenMech.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2MoltenMech.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMech.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - "Prepare Your Defenses" Trailer|'''Molten Mech''' on a promotional video. Valentines Crate 2026 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Molten Mech''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMoltenMech.png|'''Molten Mech''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0]] **'''Molten Mech''' added. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **Health increased from 1,500 to 1,750. **Speed Increased from Slightly Fast (5.5) to Fast (7). **Defense of 25% added. *'''9 April 2025''' - [[v1.60.0]] **Now appears in Molten Arena [[PVP]], where it has 2,500 health. *'''23 April 2025''' - [[v1.62.0]] **No longer appears in the [[PVP Test]] as it has been removed. *'''23 July 2025''' - [[v1.71.0]] **Now appears in Molten Arena [[PVP]], carrying over all of its [[PVP Test]] statistics. *'''12 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3a]] **Now appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]] Master difficulty as part of [[The Takeover Event]]. ***Has 1,800 health in [[Sk8 P4rk]]. *'''22 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3g]] **No longer appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]], as it has been removed. *28 January 2026 - [[v1.84.0]] **First wave appearance changed from 24 to 23 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. **Health increased from 1,750 to 1,800 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. **Health increased from 1,750 to 2,000 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **Speed increased from Fast (7) to Very Fast (8). **[[Defense]] increased from 25% to 40%. **Cash given increased from {{Money|750}} to {{Money|1,500}} every 50% health lost in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. **Cash given increased from {{Money|750}} to {{Money|1,200}} every 50% health lost in Molten Arena [[PVP]]. **[[Stun Immunity]] removed. **Size increased. {{Molten|[[Molten Hound]]|Wave 22|Molten Mech|Wave 23|[[Bulwark]]|Wave 25}} {{MidRank|[[Hazmat]]|Wave 17|[[Hidden Boss]] & Molten Mech|Wave 20|[[Breaker4]]|Wave 24}} {{TakeoverMaster|[[Breaker4]]|Wave 15|Molten Mech|Wave 16|[[Bulwark]] & [[Tanker]]|Wave 17}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
